content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

Stop and assess first. Lower back pain after deadlifts is a warning sign—sharp or persistent pain means stop immediately and see a professional. Even if it's just soreness, check your form: deadlifts demand a neutral spine, proper hip hinge, and core bracing. If form looks good and it's mild, try lighter weight and stay within a pain-free range of motion to build tolerance safely.
